answer: A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The saffron counter is kept in basalt and zephyr shows each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 571 identities would post 2563 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
